title: Old release saves a whole record over a new release's update
description: During a rolling deploy, the old release loads a record and saves every column back while the new release changes one of them.

requirements.text: Saving an unrelated field from the old release must not undo a committed plan change.
assumptions: change_plan is the only source of intentional plan changes; change_email is never meant to alter plan.

requirements.text: A committed email change must be preserved.
